task: Resolve the safe, no-eval half of issue #2840 (ADR-080 model-pin migration): de-version every skill and command model pin, regenerate the Copilot mirrors, drain the governance baseline, and close the regrowth sources. Flag the agent + generator half as owner-gated because agent_registry requires a model field and ADR-080 step 2b conflicts with ADR-002/templates.md.

events.content: Reviewed the full #2840 discourse and ADR-080. Found local main 101 commits behind origin; ADR-080 governance check, baseline, and manifest already shipped in #3071. Branched feat/2840-model-pin-migration from fresh origin/main.

Ground-truthed the state: baseline 113 grandfathered pins, warn mode wired into pre_pr, manifest empty. Confirmed the check contract: skills/commands may not carry a versioned id; a bare alias is legal only when it prices below the default (haiku only).

De-versioned 74 skills + 1 command via a scripted frontmatter transform: sonnet/opus versioned ids removed (inherit); haiku ids converted to bare alias plus a cost model-rationale. YAML re-parsed clean on all 121 files, zero residual versioned pins.

Regenerated the Copilot skill mirrors (build_all): 73 mirrors updated (merge-resolver correctly omitted from the ship set). Closed the regrowth sources: SkillForge skill-md-template, output-structure examples, github/fix-ci pin, and the .claude/skills/CLAUDE.md model-selection guidance.

Drained the baseline 113 to 46 (frozen_count lowered to 46) and reran the check: warn OK, enforce exit 0, 31 tests green. Confirmed agent_registry.py requires model on agents, which is why the agent half stays owner-gated (removing agent pins breaks validation; keeping them fails the alias rule).

De-versioned 66 skills + 1 command via a scripted frontmatter transform: sonnet/opus versioned ids removed (inherit); haiku ids converted to bare alias plus a cost model-rationale. Excluded 8 skills whose pre-existing structural or em-dash debt the per-file validators surfaced on touch (out of #2840 scope); they keep their pins and stay grandfathered.

Taught the SkillForge validator the model-rationale property (_constants.py, per ADR-080 point 4) so the haiku alias skills validate.
